AI_CHAT.TITLE: AI Assistant
AI_CHAT.EMPTY_STATE: Start a conversation with the AI assistant.
AI_CHAT.ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
AI_CHAT.WELCOME_SUBTITLE: Ask me anything about your workspace, tasks, or projects.

SETTINGS.TITLE: AI Providers
SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Bring your own API keys: configure per-tenant credentials for the registered AI providers used by the AI chat.
SETTINGS.NO_PROVIDERS: No AI providers are registered on the server.
SETTINGS.PLATFORM_NOTICE: You are using the shared free tier — no API key of your own is configured. Free models are rate limited and the limit is shared with everyone else using it. Connect your own account or enter an API key below for uninterrupted access and the full model list.

FORM.API_KEY_KEEP: Leave blank to keep the current key.
FORM.BASE_URL_INVALID: Base URL must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
FORM.MODELS_NOT_FOUND: No matching model — pick "Custom model…" to type an id.
FORM.MODELS_PLATFORM: Limited to the free models available on the shared key. Add your own API key to use any model.
FORM.MODELS_PLATFORM_UNAVAILABLE: The shared free-tier model list could not be loaded, so no model can be selected. Add your own API key to use this provider.
FORM.MODELS_CUSTOM_ENDPOINT: This provider uses a custom base URL, so its model list is not fetched — your key belongs to that endpoint, not to the vendor. Pick "Custom model…" to enter a model id.
FORM.MODELS_CURATED_NO_KEY: Showing known models. Save an API key to load everything this provider offers.
FORM.MODELS_CURATED_UNAVAILABLE: Showing known models — the provider's full list could not be loaded just now.
FORM.MODELS_STALE: Showing the last known list — the provider's catalogue could not be refreshed.
FORM.MODELS_NOT_CHAT_CAPABLE: Chat through this provider is not available yet — pick another provider to chat. A key saved here takes effect once support ships.
FORM.API_KEY_OPTIONAL: Optional — this server usually runs without an API key. Leave it blank unless yours is behind an authenticating proxy.
FORM.BASE_URL_REQUIRED: A base URL is required for this provider — enter the address of your server.
FORM.BASE_URL_GATEWAY_HINT: The address of your OpenAI-compatible server or gateway, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama), http://localhost:1234/v1 (LM Studio), http://localhost:8000/v1 (vLLM).
FORM.BASE_URL_LOCAL_HINT: The address of your local server. The usual default is prefilled — change it if your server listens elsewhere.
FORM.SPEECH_MODEL_HINT: The speech-to-text model used when this provider transcribes dictation in the AI chat.
FORM.CUSTOM_SPEECH_MODEL_PLACEHOLDER: Enter a speech model id (e.g. whisper-1)
FORM.USE_AS_VOICE_DEFAULT_HINT: Dictation in the AI chat tries this provider first. Without a default, the first configured provider that can transcribe is used.
FORM.VOICE_ONLY_NOTICE: This provider transcribes speech for dictation only — it has no chat models. Choose another provider for chat.

VOICE.TITLE: Voice (dictation)
VOICE.DESCRIPTION: Providers that can transcribe speech for dictation in the AI chat. The default is tried first; the others are fallbacks.
VOICE.EMPTY: No voice provider yet — dictation in the AI chat is off.
VOICE.EMPTY_HINT: Add a provider that supports speech-to-text: OpenAI, Groq, Mistral, Deepgram, ElevenLabs — or a local server (Speaches, LocalAI, whisper.cpp) that needs no API key.

DELETE_CONFIRM.TITLE: Delete credential
DELETE_CONFIRM.MESSAGE: Delete the {{provider}} API credential for this tenant? AI chat may stop working for this provider.

TOASTR.ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
TOASTR.CONNECT_WORKSPACE_MISMATCH: This Connect flow was started in a different workspace. Switch back to that workspace and try again.
TOASTR.CONNECT_SESSION_EXPIRED: The Connect session has expired or was started in another tab. Please click Connect again.

CATALOG.TITLE: Add AI Provider
CATALOG.DESCRIPTION: Choose a provider to connect or configure with your own API key.
CATALOG.VOICE_DESCRIPTION: Choose a provider that can transcribe speech for dictation in the AI chat — a cloud service with your own API key, or a local server running on your own hardware (no key needed).
CATALOG.NO_VOICE_PROVIDERS: No speech-capable AI provider is registered on this server.

CONNECT.HINT: Opens the provider website — authorize there and you will be brought back with the connection ready. No copy/paste needed.
CONNECT.OR_MANUAL: or enter an API key manually

STATUS.READY_HINT: Open it any time from the "AI Chat" button in the header, at the top right of every page.
STATUS.NO_PERMISSION_TITLE: AI chat is configured, but hidden for your role
STATUS.NO_PERMISSION_HINT: Your role does not have AI chat access — ask an admin to enable the AI_CHAT_ACCESS permission.
STATUS.GLOBALLY_DISABLED_TITLE: AI chat is turned off on this server
STATUS.GLOBALLY_DISABLED_HINT: AI chat is disabled by server configuration (GAUZY_AI_CHAT_ENABLED). Ask your system administrator to enable it.
STATUS.CREDENTIALS_UNUSABLE_HINT: A credential is saved, but the server cannot use it. Make sure the provider is enabled, then enter the API key again.
STATUS.UNREACHABLE_HINT: The AI chat configuration could not be loaded. Reload the page or try again in a moment.
